author: Corridor Crew
description:
Recently, a Fox News interview went viral after a common guest, Robert Harward, appeared on air with what many flagged as a clear sign that the person shown was someone wearing a mask.

Is Fox News deceiving us all with one of the most ultrarealistic masks we've ever seen, or can this be explained by something as simple as poor lighting?
title: Was he wearing A MASK ON NATIONAL TV?
